integrity: Exact finite enumeration and a symbolic general proof are included; no independent mathematical audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Labelled reflexive finite frames, one-step Δp under changeable atomic valuations, all-world noiseless truth vectors only.
Random success is universal reconstruction by a sampled family, not recovery of one random frame.
Classical coupon-collector asymptotics and established non-contingency semantics are credited; an equivalent older inverse-problem treatment remains possible.
title: Sharp active–passive tomography of finite reflexive non-contingency frames
